purpose: Test the remaining first-order projection context families without expanding V1 beyond evidence-supported complexity.

age_career_stage.notes: RB includes age-by-recent-touch interaction; WR age-by-target-volume; QB age-by-rushing-dependence; TE retains nonlinear age/career stage.

team_context.notes: Uses only prior-season team opportunity/environment totals selected by position; no target-season realized team statistics.

validation.retain_rule: Keep only position/family combinations that add material and reasonably stable held-out improvement; reject blanket additions.
validation.complexity_rule: After these first-order families, stop core feature expansion unless residual-error analysis identifies a material gap.
